name: Dawnlight Chapel
deity: God of Light · Lord of the Dawn

services.name: Prayer
services.effect: Peace of mind; removes the fear/confusion status

services.name: Purification
services.effect: Removes a curse or negative magical effect

lore: This chapel was built when Jadestone's mining first began — said to be for holding down something deep in the mine.
The chapel's white stone is not local; it is holy stone brought from the distant south.
Father Silas was 'reassigned' here from Mistlake ten years ago, but those in the know say he actually asked to come himself.
